'''Hangar 25''' was a hangar located at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Peragus Mining Facility]] during the [[Old Sith Wars]].<ref name="KOTOR II" /> In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Dark Wars]], [[T3-M4]] docked there in the [[Ebon Hawk]] after the ''[[Harbinger]]'', bound for [[Telos IV]], was infiltrated by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] lead by [[Darth Sion]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] [[Meetra Surik]] later escaped from Sion with T3-M4 and [[Atton Rand]] in the docked Ebon Hawk.<ref name="KOTOR II" />
